provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks change that has accumulated up to the present, or motion oriented toward the speaker: 風が強くなってきた for a state that has newly emerged, 買ってくる for going, doing it, and coming back. 〜ていく sends the same change forward and away from now. The humble counterpart is 〜てまいる and the honorific 〜ていらっしゃる.

examples.ruby: 夕方[ゆうがた]から急[きゅう]に風[かぜ]が強[つよ]くなってきた。
examples.english: The wind has suddenly picked up since early evening.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]し先[さき]の暮[く]らしにもだんだん慣[な]れてきました。
examples.english: I've gradually gotten used to life in my new place.

examples.ruby: ちょっとコンビニで牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]を買[か]ってくる。
examples.english: I'm just going to run to the convenience store for some milk.

patterns.usage_note: Reports change or continuation reaching the present, in humble register: 朝晩は冷え込んでまいりました, 開店以来同じ味を守ってまいりました. It is the standard wording for seasonal greetings and for recounting what you or your company has done to date. The non-past 〜てまいります points forward instead, like 〜ていく, and as a humble form it describes your own side or impersonal happenings, not a respected person's actions.

examples.ruby: 朝晩[あさばん]はずいぶん冷[ひ]え込[こ]んでまいりました。
examples.english: Mornings and evenings have turned quite chilly now.

examples.ruby: 当店[とうてん]は開店[かいてん]以来[いらい]、同[おな]じ味[あじ]を守[まも]り続[つづ]けてまいりました。
examples.english: We have kept the same flavor alive ever since the day this shop opened.

examples.ruby: 桜[さくら]の便[たよ]りが南[みなみ]から届[とど]いてまいりました。
examples.english: Word of the cherry blossoms has come up to us from the south.

patterns.usage_note: Honorific of 〜てくる: a person you are elevating comes or arrives while doing something, or brings someone or something with them (戻っていらっしゃいました, 花束を抱えて入っていらっしゃった). The sibling lane of this same form is the honorific of 〜ている, an action in progress or a continuing state (書いていらっしゃいます); a verb of motion toward the speaker marks this lane. For your own movement use 〜てまいります.

examples.ruby: 社長[しゃちょう]がこちらへ戻[もど]っていらっしゃいました。
examples.english: The president has come back over here.

examples.ruby: お客様[きゃくさま]が大[おお]きな花束[はなたば]を抱[かか]えて入[はい]っていらっしゃった。
examples.english: A customer came in cradling an enormous bouquet.

examples.ruby: 恩師[おんし]がわざわざ我[わ]が家[や]まで訪[たず]ねていらっしゃった。
examples.english: My old teacher went out of his way to come all the way to our house.
